title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

 ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next\-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
   

  

 Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud\-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and \- through our product SIMS \- collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.
   

  

 ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.
   

  

 Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Development** 
 : design, code, test, and debug software solutions in accordance with project specifications. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
   

**Coding and Documentation:** 
 write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code. Maintain comprehensive documentation for code and software features.
   

**Front end web development** 
 : ability to design, create and evolve user\-facing applications to be scalable, maintainable, secure, aesthetic and usable within the constraints imposed by the browser using a combination of languages, design skills, and client\-side scripts and frameworks.
   

**Backend development** 
 : ability to write, maintain and design the business logic of a software application, the data or services requested are available as well as create and maintain the core databases, data and application program interfaces (APIs) to other backend processes.
   

**Database Management** 
 : knowledge of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle). Competence in writing and optimizing SQL queries.
   

**Version Control** 
 : proficient in using the Git version control systems.
   

**Testing and Debugging** 
 : experience with testing frameworks (e.g. XUnit) and debugging tools.
   

 Knowledge of test\-driven development (TDD) principles.
   

**DevOps** 
 : basic understanding of DevOps practices, continuous integration, and deployment.
   

**Cloud Computing** 
 : familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
   

**Collaboration:** 
 work closely with team members to understand project requirements and collaborate on project goals. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
   

**Adaptability** 
 : stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. Adapt to new tools, languages, and methodologies as required by projects.
   

**Quality Assurance:** 
 implement coding standards to ensure high\-quality, bug\-free code.
   

**Development Principles** 
 : implement industry standard development principles and frameworks for achieving quality, speed and maintainability. This includes the practices, techniques and tools that support those principles, and an understanding of when things may or may not be applicable in a situation or context.
   

**Giving and Receiving Feedback** 
 : solicit and engage with feedback on a continuous basis. Having timely, actionable and meaningful conversations about quality and performance for the purpose of improving effectiveness.
   

**Emotional Intelligence** 
 : recognizes, understands and manages their own emotions and recognizes, understands, shares and influences the emotions of others. Collaboration: works jointly with others to co\-create and achieve a common goal. This includes learning, practising and experimenting with tools, techniques and frameworks that foster collaborative working environments.
   

**Ownership and Accountability** 
 : takes personal accountability and ownership for their work. This includes personal follow through, making and defending difficult decisions and tradeoffs, removing blockers, driving collective progress.
   

**Continuous Improvement** 
 : advances by ongoing, incremental improvement through continuous learning, questioning the status quo and trying out creative and novel ideas. Shows curiosity and has a keen interest to drive learning for themselves and others.
   

**Systems Thinking** 
 : Positively impact complex systems or domains by understanding the whole picture and the interdependencies of its component parts. Maintain strong expertise and knowledge of current and emerging technologies and products.
   

  

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 • Communication skills (both written and verbal) demonstrated at all levels of the organisation
   

 • Software development skills (.NET Framework, .NET Core, C\#, VB.Net, React, MVC, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Xamarin, Java / XCode)
   

 • Cloud computing, particularly Microsoft Azure, with experience of deploying and managing applications in the cloud
   

 • RESTful API development
   

 • Testing framework knowledge (XUnit, Moq) and test driven development experience
   

 • Experience of source code control and release management (CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps)
   

 • Knowledge of API testing (Postman).
   

 • Database management, extensive query skills and ORM (Entity Framework) experience
   

 • Agile development methodologies: Kanban, Scrum, XP, Lean.

description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Software Integration Engineer
   

  

**Overview**
 The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This role requires strong experience in agile work management, integration testing, quality assurance, requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, troubleshooting, web services, workflow management, and test automation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will plan, prioritize, and manage work using agile practices to enable iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement. They will partner with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify issues, improve quality, and promote maintainability and coding standards.
   

  

 This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
   

  

 The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
* Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.
* Design, execute, and maintain integration tests to validate interactions between systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to review requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability throughout the SDLC.
* Support SDLC activities including requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance to ensure solutions remain high quality and maintainable.
* Contribute to systems integration by validating communication, interoperability, and reliability across diverse technologies, processes, applications, and services.
* Implement and support UI, API, backend, and integration automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.
* Support API performance testing and performance validation using tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, test environments, and networks using structured methods and tools.
* Evaluate source code written by developers to identify and address potential issues, support maintainability, improve quality, and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
* Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof\-of\-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.


**All About You / Experience**
 The ideal candidate for this position should have:
   

  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.
* Ability to apply skills independently and consistently in complex or nuanced situations while supporting broader business, delivery, and quality goals.
* Strong knowledge of agile principles and practices, including planning, prioritization, iterative delivery, collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience collaborating with developers and engineering teams to review source code, identify potential issues, improve maintainability, and promote coding standards and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with UI and API automation tools such as Playwright and Cypress.
* Strong experience in API integration testing and backend validation.
* Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions.
* Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
* Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks.
* Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems.
* Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes.
* Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia.
* Experience with test case management tools such as XRay.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators.
* Ability to work on proof\-of\-concepts.

title: Project Manager (with Scrum Master skills)
description:
Ascentt is building cutting\-edge data analytics \& AI/ML solutions for global automotive and manufacturing leaders. We turn enterprise data into real\-time decisions using advanced machine learning and GenAI. Our team solves hard engineering problems at scale, with real\-world industry impact. We’re hiring passionate builders to shape the future of industrial intelligence.
   

  

**Project Manager (with Scrum Master Skills)**
****Locations:****
 Indore, Madhya Pradesh/ Pune
   

  

****Work Arrangement:****
 Office\-based
   

  

****Role Type:****
 Full\-time
   

  

**About Ascentt**
 Ascentt is a technology consulting and AI services firm that partners with global enterprises to deliver complex data, AI, and digital transformation programs. Our teams work directly with enterprise client stakeholders on high\-visibility engagements where delivery discipline, transparency, and outcomes matter. We offer a collaborative environment, direct exposure to global clients, and the opportunity to shape how modern Agile delivery works on AI\-driven programs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Project Manager at Ascentt, you will lead the Agile delivery of one cross\-functional Scrum team building technology and AI\-driven solutions for enterprise clients.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on Agile leadership role. The delivery environment entails enterprise\-scale programs, cross\-team dependencies, and direct engagement with client stakeholders. The seniority of this role lies in the judgment it requires, knowing when to coach, when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who
 ****leans into problems, engages the right people, drives closure, challenges teams constructively, and operates comfortably with internal and client stakeholders.****
****Work Location \& Client Collaboration****
 This is an
 ****office\-based position****
 at Ascentt's Indore or Pune location. Regular presence in the office is required.
   

  

 Because Ascentt works with global enterprise clients, the Senior Scrum Master will need the flexibility to
 ****overlap with U.S. client working hours as needed****
 for Agile ceremonies, stakeholder discussions, planning sessions, and issue resolution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
****Project Leadership \& Planning****
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects, also serving as Scrum Master for the delivery team
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, and timelines
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans; track progress, dependencies, and critical path


****AI\-Enabled Project Management****
* Leverage AI tools to streamline project tracking, generate status summaries, and surface risks or delays earlier
* Use AI\-assisted reporting to improve turnaround and consistency of status updates to leadership
* Drive adoption of AI\-driven PM tools and practices as part of continuous process improvement


****Stakeholder \& Team Coordination****
* Coordinate internal technical teams, business teams, and third\-party vendors
* Facilitate communication between engineering teams, product owners, and business stakeholders
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives


**Risk, Issue \& Requirements Management**
* Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and escalations
* Identify potential roadblocks and drive timely resolution
* Ensure technical requirements are clearly defined, documented, and understood by development teams


****Performance Monitoring \& Reporting****
* Monitor project performance, schedules, budgets, and key delivery metrics
* Prepare and present regular project status reports to leadership and stakeholders


****Agile Delivery (Scrum Master)****
* Serve as Scrum Master for one cross\-functional Agile delivery team, leading sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives)
* Ensure ceremonies produce clear decisions, commitments, and actions — and that the team establishes and stays focused on clear sprint goals.
* Partner with the Product Owner to maintain a healthy, prioritized, appropriately refined backlog.
* Surface unclear requirements, unresolved questions, dependencies, and readiness gaps before work enters a sprint.
* Use Agile metrics (predictability, carryover, cycle time, throughput) to to identify trends and drive team improvement.
* Coach the team on Agile principles, accountability, and effective performance of their roles.


****Process Improvement****
* Drive continuous improvement in project management processes and delivery methodologies


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of overall experience in software development or technology delivery environments, including experience managing technical projects end\-to\-end.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Agile delivery leader for cross\-functional software or technology teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading project planning and delivery — scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder reporting — alongside facilitating the full set of Scrum ceremonies and applying Agile principles in real\-world delivery environments.
* Strong track record identifying and driving resolution of impediments, delivery risks, dependencies, and cross\-team escalations.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery metrics (velocity, burndown, cycle time) and traditional project metrics (schedule, budget, milestones), and how to apply both to improve predictability and delivery outcomes.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for project tracking, status reporting, or risk surfacing, with an interest in driving continued adoption of AI\-driven PM practices.
* Proficiency with Jira or comparable Agile/project work\-management tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders and present to leadership.
* Experience in distributed or global delivery environments, with flexibility to overlap with U.S. client hours as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI\-ACP, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience with enterprise clients in a consulting environment.
* Exposure to AI, Generative AI, data, cloud, or other emerging\-technology delivery environments.
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or related industries.


**What Success Looks Like**
 A successful project manager with scrum master skills creates an environment in which:
   

  

* Projects deliver on scope, schedule, and budget, with risks and dependencies caught early
* Sprints run predictably — stable velocity, few blockers, high\-value ceremonies
* Status reporting to leadership is fast, clear, and AI\-assisted
* Engineering, product, and business teams stay aligned with minimal miscommunication or rework
* Impediments and escalations get resolved quickly
* AI tools are actively used to reduce manual PM overhead
* Delivery processes keep improving sprint over sprint
* Distributed team members stay fully integrated across time zones


 Ultimately, this role’s impact is visible in the team's ability to anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, make better decisions, and consistently deliver valuable outcomes.

title: Lead Software Release Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Software Release Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Software Release Manager to lead end\-to\-end release planning, scheduling, and orchestration across a portfolio of 7\-8 interconnected software products and platforms. This role is responsible for establishing and maintaining an integrated release calendar that balances product roadmaps, engineering capacity, testing environment availability, customer commitments, regulatory requirements, and cross\-program dependencies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in complex enterprise environments where multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders must coordinate to successfully deliver high\-quality software releases. This individual will serve as the central point of coordination for release readiness, dependency management, environment planning, and deployment execution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Planning \& Scheduling
   

  

* Own the enterprise release calendar across 7\-8 products and platforms.
* Develop and maintain integrated release schedules accounting for:
* Development milestones
* Integration testing windows
* Pre\-production validation
* Performance and scalability testing
* Production deployment windows
* Customer onboarding and certification timelines
* Coordinate release trains and major program increments across multiple teams.
* Balance competing priorities while optimizing release frequency and stability.


 Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, document, track, and proactively manage:
* Product\-to\-product dependencies
* Program\-to\-program dependencies
* Infrastructure dependencies
* Vendor and external partner dependencies
* Customer readiness dependencies
* Facilitate dependency review forums and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Resolve schedule conflicts and escalation issues impacting release delivery.


 Environment \& Capacity Management
   

  

* Govern utilization of critical testing and deployment environments, including:
* Integration environments
* System testing environments
* UAT environments
* Performance testing environments
* Pre\-production environments
* Production environments
* Coordinate environment reservations and conflict resolution across multiple teams.
* Ensure environment readiness, availability, and release sequencing.


 Release Readiness \& Governance
   

  

* Establish release entry and exit criteria.
* Conduct release readiness reviews and go/no\-go assessments.
* Verify completion of:
* Functional testing
* Integration testing
* Regression testing
* Performance testing
* Security validation
* Operational readiness activities
* Ensure change management and release governance processes are followed.


 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Partner closely with:
* Engineering teams
* Product Managers
* Program Managers
* Quality Engineering teams
* Site Reliability Engineering teams
* Infrastructure teams
* Customer delivery teams
* Operations and Support organizations
* Communicate release plans, risks, constraints, and status to both technical and executive audiences.
* Drive alignment across globally distributed teams.


 Risk \& Issue Management
   

  

* Identify schedule, environment, resource, and operational risks early.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Lead release war rooms for major deployments.
* Track and drive resolution of release blockers and critical dependencies.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define and monitor release management KPIs, including:
* Release predictability
* On\-time delivery
* Deployment success rate
* Environment utilization
* Defect leakage
* Change failure rate
* Continuously improve release planning processes, tooling, and governance.


**All About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in software delivery, technical program management, release management, or engineering operations.
* 5\+ years managing enterprise\-scale software releases.
* Experience coordinating releases across multiple products and engineering teams simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of:
* SDLC
* Agile and Scrum methodologies
* DevOps practices
* CI/CD pipelines
* Change and release management processes
* Demonstrated experience managing complex dependency chains and cross\-functional delivery programs.
* Strong project planning, organization, and risk\-management skills.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder\-management capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in large\-scale distributed systems or payment\-processing platforms.
* Experience coordinating releases across globally distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of tools such as:
* Jira
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub Actions
* Jenkins
* XL Release / Digital.ai Release
* Splunk
* Confluence
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, ITIL, or DevOps certifications.
* Experience supporting highly regulated or mission\-critical production environments.


 Success Measures
   

  

**A Successful Software Release Manager Will**
* Maintain a synchronized release schedule across 7\-8 products with minimal conflicts.
* Improve release predictability and on\-time delivery.
* Reduce environment contention and resource bottlenecks.
* Ensure all customer, platform, program, and infrastructure dependencies are proactively managed.
* Deliver production releases with high deployment success rates and low operational impact.
* Provide leadership visibility into release health, risks, and readiness.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
